steps.title: Open ADD on the job
steps.body: From the job, click + ADD at the bottom of the screen. A payable invoice is the send-it-and-relax way to get paid — the customer enters their own card.

steps.title: Choose Payment
steps.body: Pick Payment from the menu — a payable invoice is one of the payment options inside.

steps.title: Check the amount
steps.body: Make sure the Payment Amount is what you want to collect. Amount due covers the full balance; requesting a deposit goes on the Custom line.

steps.title: Send Payable Invoice
steps.body: Click your processor — UrPay, Stripe or Square — and pick Send Payable Invoice.

steps.title: Pick SMS or Email
steps.body: Choose the channel and hit SEND. The toggle hides per-item quantities and unit prices if you'd rather the request show one clean number.

steps.title: Include tipping
steps.body: Urable asks if you want tipping on this request — click YES. Customers tip more when it's one tap at payment time.

steps.title: What your customer gets
steps.body: A $2,884.00 Payment Request with a full payment form built in — card or ACH, Google Pay, and a checkbox that saves their card for next time.

steps.title: One green button
steps.body: They scroll, they tap PAY, you get paid — and their card lands on file for every job after this one. Need an informational invoice instead? Send PDF under the job's line items sends a PDF version with no payment link.
